description:
We’re Hiring: Account Manager!
We build AI-powered tools that reshape how organisations understand and develop their people. Great tools only matter when clients actually get value from them. That’s where you come in.
We’re looking for an Account Manager who keeps our corporate clients well served, well delivered, and growing with us.

What you’ll do
• Manage and grow your allocated client accounts. You are their go-to person at PEEPL.
• Coordinate project delivery with internal departments, from kickoff to final report.
• Prepare proposals, quotations, and client documents that win the next project.
• Spot upselling and cross-selling opportunities. Growth is part of the job.
• Handle client complaints quickly and within SLA.
• Keep client administration tidy in Odoo and the Client Folder.

If you love building long-term client relationships and turning them into growth, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now!
qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree with 2+ years in account management, client services, or B2B sales.
  • Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Comfortable juggling multiple accounts with Microsoft Office and CRM systems.
  • Basic knowledge of ISO standards.
  • Bonus: active English, Odoo CRM, experience presenting SaaS/HR platforms to corporate clients, contract review and tender processes, and using AI tools in your daily work.

description:
• Menganalisis dan mengoptimalkan alur produksi untuk meningkatkan produktivitas dan mengurangi hambatan produksi.
  • Mengurangi pemborosan bahan baku dan biaya operasional.
  • Memastikan proses sesuai standar kualitas dan keamanan pangan (HACCP, ISO 22000).
  • Monitoring KPI produksi seperti OEE dan membuat laporan performa.
  • Menjalankan program continuous improvement seperti Kaizen, 5S, dan Gemba Walk.

qualifications:
• Pendidikan S1: Teknik Industri, Teknik Kimia, Teknologi Pangan, atau jurusan terkait.
  • Pengalaman minimal 3 tahun level supervisor di bidang Operational/Manufacturing Excellence, Process
  • Engineering, atau QA di industri food/pet food.
  • Memiliki sertifikasi Lean Six Sigma (minimal Green Belt, Black Belt lebih disukai).
  • Menguasai:
  • * Dmaic, VSM, RCA, TPM, FMEA
  • * Kaizen, 5S, Kanban
  • * OEE tracking dan continuous improvement
  • Paham standar HACCP, GMP, ISO 22000, FSMA.
  • Memiliki kemampuan analitis, problem solving, dan project management yang baik.
  • Bersedia ditempatkan di Banyuasin, Sumatera Selatan

job_title: MAGANG BAKTI CUSTOMER SERVICE PEMBUKAAN REKENING ONLINE
description:
Magang Bakti Customer Service - Pembukaan Rekening Online cocok untuk kamu yang menyukai dunia layanan perbankan. Kamu akan mendapatkan training, pengalaman di bidang operasional perbankan serta ilmu lainnya untuk membantu kamu menjadi seorang yang profesional.

Kamu akan bertanggung jawab melayani nasabah dalam proses pembukaan rekening secara online.

Informasi Seleksi:
BCA bekerjasama dengan PT Sentral Layanan Prima (SLP) & PT IFO CharCom Empowerment untuk proses seleksi Magang Bakti area Jabodetabek.

Hati-hati terhadap penipuan yang mengatasnamakan BCA.

Seluruh proses rekrutmen dan seleksi BCA tidak dipungut biaya apapun.
qualifications:
• WNI pria atau wanita berusia 18 s/d 24 tahun
  • Lulusan SMA / SMK (nilai rata-rata rapor semester 5 & 6 min. 70)
  • Lulusan D1 - D3 atau S1 (IPK min. 2,50)
  • Senang berinteraksi dengan orang lain
  • Ramah, terampil, solutif, teliti, dan mampu berkomunikasi dengan baik
  • Memiliki kemampuan dasar komputer yang baik
  • Belum pernah mengikuti Program Pemagangan Bakti BCA sebelumnya
  • Belum menikah dan bersedia untuk tidak menikah selama program pemagangan
  • Bersedia penempatan di area Serpong/Tangerang atau Semarang dengan jam kerja shifting

description:
• Melakukan pengurusan surat izin Perusahaan dengan melakukan koordinasi dengan pihak terkait
  • Bertanggung jawab atas perawatan aset Perusahaan dan pengadaan barang kantor.
  • Monitoring dan menyediakan kebutuhan ATK dan Rumah Tangga perusahaan.
  • Bertanggung jawab atas kebersihan gedung, ruangan dan lingkungan kantor.
  • Menganalisa atas kerusakan yang terjadi dari segi peralatan maupun gedung perusahaan.
  • Pemeliharaan dan perawatan fasilitas, peralatan dan infrastruktur perusahaan mencakup pemeliharaan gedung, perbaikan peralatan kantor, serta mengatur jadwal service dan perawatan kendaraan untuk memastikan semua beroperasi dengan baik.
  • Bertanggung jawab dalam proses administrasi dan kelengkapan dokumen karyawan.

• Pria (Fresh Graduate/Berpengalaman dipersilahkan)
  • Usia maksimal 30 tahun
  • Pendidikan min S1 semua jurusan
  • Disiplin, jujur, pekerja keras, dan kreatif
  • Berkomunikasi dengan baik, bertanggung jawab, dan bisa bekerja sama dalam tim

description:
• Menyiapkan dan mengolah makanan sesuai menu, standar resep, dan jadwal operasional catering.
  • Memastikan kualitas, rasa, penyajian, dan porsi makanan sesuai standar perusahaan.
  • Mengawasi proses persiapan bahan makanan serta memastikan penggunaan bahan baku secara efisien.
  • Membimbing dan mengarahkan Cook dan Kitchen Helper dalam operasional dapur.
  • Memastikan kebersihan area dapur, peralatan, dan penyimpanan bahan makanan sesuai standar hygiene dan sanitasi.
  • Memastikan seluruh proses pengolahan makanan mematuhi standar Food Safety, HACCP, dan GMP.
  • Berkoordinasi dengan Supervisor Catering terkait kebutuhan operasional dapur dan ketersediaan bahan baku.
  • Membantu melakukan stock opname serta mengontrol penggunaan bahan makanan untuk meminimalkan waste.
qualifications:
• Minimal SMA/SMK Tata Boga atau D3 Tata Boga/Perhotelan.
  • Memiliki pengalaman minimal 3 tahun sebagai Senior Cook, Cook Leader, atau Cook di catering mining, camp, oil & gas, industrial catering, atau institusi.
  • Mampu memasak dalam jumlah besar (high volume catering) dengan kualitas yang konsisten.
  • Memahami standar Food Safety, HACCP, GMP, Hygiene & Sanitasi.
  • Memiliki kemampuan memimpin tim dapur dan mengatur alur kerja kitchen.
  • Bersedia bekerja dengan sistem roster dan ditempatkan di site.

description:
We’re Hiring: Account Manager!
We build AI-powered tools that reshape how organisations understand and develop their people. Great tools only matter when clients actually get value from them. That’s where you come in.
We’re looking for an Account Manager who keeps our corporate clients well served, well delivered, and growing with us.

What you’ll do
• Manage and grow your allocated client accounts. You are their go-to person at PEEPL.
• Coordinate project delivery with internal departments, from kickoff to final report.
• Prepare proposals, quotations, and client documents that win the next project.
• Spot upselling and cross-selling opportunities. Growth is part of the job.
• Handle client complaints quickly and within SLA.
• Keep client administration tidy in Odoo and the Client Folder.

If you love building long-term client relationships and turning them into growth, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now!
qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree with 2+ years in account management, client services, or B2B sales.
  • Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Comfortable juggling multiple accounts with Microsoft Office and CRM systems.
  • Basic knowledge of ISO standards.
  • Bonus: active English, Odoo CRM, experience presenting SaaS/HR platforms to corporate clients, contract review and tender processes, and using AI tools in your daily work.

description:
We’re Hiring: Account Manager!
We build AI-powered tools that reshape how organisations understand and develop their people. Great tools only matter when clients actually get value from them. That’s where you come in.
We’re looking for an Account Manager who keeps our corporate clients well served, well delivered, and growing with us.

What you’ll do
• Manage and grow your allocated client accounts. You are their go-to person at PEEPL.
• Coordinate project delivery with internal departments, from kickoff to final report.
• Prepare proposals, quotations, and client documents that win the next project.
• Spot upselling and cross-selling opportunities. Growth is part of the job.
• Handle client complaints quickly and within SLA.
• Keep client administration tidy in Odoo and the Client Folder.

If you love building long-term client relationships and turning them into growth, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now!
qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree with 2+ years in account management, client services, or B2B sales.
  • Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Comfortable juggling multiple accounts with Microsoft Office and CRM systems.
  • Basic knowledge of ISO standards.
  • Bonus: active English, Odoo CRM, experience presenting SaaS/HR platforms to corporate clients, contract review and tender processes, and using AI tools in your daily work.
